name: Resume-Safe Program Checkpointing
description: Structure a long program so a kill, a compaction or a session loss resumes from the last completed unit. Completion is a POSTCONDITION ON THE ARTIFACT, never 'the agent said done': a unit whose artifact still reads 'UNKNOWN - not yet measured' is not complete however green the run looked. Two repairs over the source design: the write-as-you-go mandate, which converts a total-loss risk into partial progress, and an explicit carve-out that no resumable boundary may be wrapped in a pipeline, because a stopped pipeline re-runs its first stage.

program_units.description: The unit ids the program is decomposed into

artifact_root.description: Where per-unit artifacts live. Partial artifacts live here, never in temp - they can carry sensitive intermediate data.

min_artifact_bytes.description: A completion predicate floor: below this the artifact is a stub, not a result

heartbeat_seconds.description: Per-unit heartbeat so a FROZEN unit is distinguishable from a merely slow one

unit_runner.description: Runs one program unit and rewrites its artifact at every milestone

checkpoint_keeper.description: Evaluates each unit's postcondition and owns the resume plan; it never asks a unit whether it finished

stages.title: S0 DEFINE a machine-checkable completion predicate per unit

work_unit.title: Write one machine-checkable postcondition per program unit
work_unit.question_or_target: For each unit define the artifact path, the minimum size, the schema it must satisfy, and the marker that disqualifies it.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: a predicate that needs judgement is not a predicate

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each predicate is expressed as a file test - exists, size, parses, schema-valid, no UNKNOWN marker - with no prose condition
tests_required: a predicate phrased as 'the agent reports success' must be REJECTED; that is self-report, not a postcondition
a predicate with no size floor must be rejected, since an empty file would satisfy exists-and-parses
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: none - a predicate is either machine-checkable or it is not
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BP3-PLN04-S0 only when every unit has a predicate composed only of file tests; otherwise FAILED:BP3-PLN04-S0 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: none; an unwritable predicate means the unit is not decomposable yet

stages.title: S1 RUN units, each writing a truthful partial from the first second

work_unit.title: Run one unit, rewriting its artifact at each milestone
work_unit.question_or_target: Execute one program unit, keeping the on-disk artifact truthful at every point so a death mid-flight still leaves usable partial progress.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive work; the artifact discipline is what makes it survivable

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the artifact existed before the work started and was rewritten at each milestone; a heartbeat distinguishes frozen from slow
tests_required: a unit killed mid-flight must leave a PARSEABLE artifact whose unmeasured rows still say UNKNOWN
a unit that wrote nothing must be classified NOT_STARTED, never inferred complete from its transcript length
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the checkpoint keeper's postcondition, which never reads the transcript
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BP3-PLN04-S1 only when the artifact parses and its unmeasured rows still carry the UNKNOWN marker; otherwise FAILED:BP3-PLN04-S1 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot; a resumed unit must not re-run a completed sibling

stages.title: S2 MARK completion only when the postcondition passes

work_unit.title: Evaluate every unit's postcondition against its artifact on disk
work_unit.question_or_target: For each unit evaluate exists, size, parses, schema-valid and no-UNKNOWN-marker, and record COMPLETE, PARTIAL or NOT_STARTED.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the postcondition must never consult the agent that produced the artifact

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each state records which sub-condition failed, so PARTIAL is actionable rather than a bare label
tests_required: an artifact still carrying the UNKNOWN marker must be PARTIAL, never COMPLETE
an artifact below the size floor must be PARTIAL even when it parses
the checker must be run against a known-incomplete artifact and shown to say PARTIAL before its COMPLETE verdicts are trusted
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: none - the predicate is the reviewer
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BP3-PLN04-S2 only when every unit carries a state and, when not COMPLETE, the sub-condition that failed; otherwise FAILED:BP3-PLN04-S2 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: none; a deterministic check that fails is a defect

stages.title: S2 gate: no unit is marked complete without an artifact check
S2b gate: an UNKNOWN marker disqualifies completion
S3 On resume, SKIP units whose predicate already passes

work_unit.title: Emit the resume plan: which units to skip and which to run
work_unit.question_or_target: Partition the units into skip and run purely from the recorded postcondition states, with no reference to any transcript.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the resume decision is a partition over recorded states

work_unit.evidence_requirement: skip and run partition the unit set exactly once, and the idempotency key for each unit is recorded
tests_required: kill the program mid-unit and resume: COMPLETE units must NOT re-run
the killed unit's partial must be truthful and it must appear in the run set
skip and run together must cover every unit exactly once
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BP3-PLN04-S3 only when skip and run partition the unit set exactly once; otherwise FAILED:BP3-PLN04-S3 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: none; a deterministic partition that fails is a defect, not a flake

stages.title: S4 ASSERT no resumable boundary is wrapped in a pipeline
S5 gate the program artifact on the shared 12-condition predicate

impact.blast_radius: writes per-unit artifacts and checkpoint state under command-center/**; partial artifacts stay under the artifact root rather than in temp because they can carry sensitive intermediate data

x_extensions.distinguishing_mechanism: completion is a POSTCONDITION on the artifact evaluated by a party that never reads the transcript, plus the pipeline carve-out. BP-INC-03 RECOVERS a run that already died without checkpoints; this prevents the loss in the first place.
repairs_over_source: the write-as-you-go mandate, referenced as a shared subworkflow rather than restated
the explicit carve-out that a resumable boundary is never wrapped in a pipeline, because a stopped pipeline re-runs its first stage
x_extensions.unverified_inline: UNVERIFIED that the pipeline first-stage-rerun defect still behaves as recorded on the current runtime; this blueprint carves around it unconditionally, which is safe either way. Settling experiment: wrap one unit in a pipeline, stop it, resume, and observe whether stage one re-runs - a both-states probe, not a single reading.

worked_example.name: an UNKNOWN marker keeps a unit out of the skip set
worked_example.narrative: Three units have artifacts on disk. u1 is fully measured and large enough: COMPLETE, and a resume must skip it. u2 parses and is large enough but still carries 'UNKNOWN - not yet measured': it is PARTIAL and must be re-run, which is the exact case where a transcript-based check would wrongly skip it. u3 is a two-byte stub: below the floor, so PARTIAL.

artifacts.u1: measured: pairs=12 groups=3 isolation=worktree; all rows measured and cited.
artifacts.u2: pairs=12; groups: UNKNOWN - not yet measured; isolation: UNKNOWN - not yet measured.

controls.mutate: replace u2's UNKNOWN rows with measured values
controls.why: the marker, not the file size, is what held u2 back - removing it must move u2 into skip
u2 must still be re-run on the marker alone, proving the two conditions are independent
